items.title: One ✕ to leave
items.body: Pause, finish or discard a workout from the same place: tap ✕ in the player.

items.title: Cleaner 3D moves
items.body: Arms no longer clip through the body when holding weights, bars sit off the neck, and floor stretches like the butterfly look right.

items.title: TV closer to live
items.body: AirPlay now trails the phone by about 2 s, and casting stops when you close the workout.
